data.description:
# Relocate favour buttons into HUD with tooltips

Move the two Community Favour buttons out of the bottom action bar and into the
widened HUD strip, strictly between the Coins and Reputation elements and adjacent
to each other in left-to-right order `[rep->coins][coins->rep]`. Preserve their
visuals, disabled states, click handlers, animation, SFX and once-per-turn gate
unchanged. Add i18n-sourced tooltips and aria labels for both buttons.

Covers parent AC3 (inside strip, adjacent, ordered), AC4 (tooltips + behaviour),
and the favour-button part of AC6 (hudContainer / transient).

## Acceptance Criteria
- Parent AC traceability: Favour buttons inside the HUD strip, adjacent and ordered. Both Community Favour buttons are rendered inside the HUD strip strictly between the Coins and Reputation elements, without overlapping either. The buttons are adjacent: the left edge of the coins to reputation button equals the right edge of the reputation to coins button (reading left-to-right: Coins ... rep-to-coins coins-to-rep ... Reputation). Verified by a unit test over the derived layout values.
- Parent AC traceability: Favour buttons keep their tooltips and existing behaviour. Each favour button carries a tooltip zone (attachHudTooltipZone) with an i18n-sourced aria label and content describing the exchange rate and the once-per-turn gate; tooltips are skipped in replay mode. The buttons remain disabled when outside MarketPhase, when state.favourUsedThisTurn is true, or when the input resource is insufficient; the exchange still plays its existing animated + SFX feedback and reduced-motion fallback.

- Both favour buttons render inside the HUD strip strictly between the Coins and
   Reputation elements, without overlapping either. Verified by a unit test over the
   derived layout values asserting `repToCoinsX + favourButtonW === coinsToRepX`
   (adjacency) and both bounding boxes within the strip and between the coin and
   reputation text bounds.
- Button construction moves from `refreshActionButtons` to the HUD render path; each
   button is parented into `s.hudContainer` and tagged with `markHudTransient`, so it
   renders above the strip and is cleaned up on the next `refreshHud()` without
   destroying persistent panels. Verified by a browser test asserting presence after
   `refreshHud()` and absence after a second refresh.
- The SLL `favourCoinsToRepButton` / `favourRepToCoinsButton` anchors are relocated
   into the HUD band (y approx 0.069) with x set so the pair sits between Coins and
   Reputation; `MainStreetLayoutAdapter` continues to derive the X values from those
   anchors with no new hardcoded pixel positions.
- Each favour button carries an `attachHudTooltipZone` with a non-empty i18n aria
   label and content describing the exact exchange rate and the once-per-turn limit;
   tooltips are skipped in replay mode. New `buildCoinsToRepTooltip` /
   `buildRepToCoinsTooltip` builders plus `HUD_TOOLTIP_STRINGS` / `HUD_TOOLTIP_I18N_KEYS` /
   `HUD_ARIA_STRINGS` / `HUD_ARIA_I18N_KEYS` entries are added and unit-tested.
- Disabled logic is preserved: the buttons are faded/disabled outside `MarketPhase`,
   when `state.favourUsedThisTurn` is true, or when the input resource is insufficient.
   Verified by a browser test asserting the disabled/enabled transitions.
- The exchange still plays its existing animated + SFX feedback (shared
   `COMMON_SFX_KEYS`, no new keys) and its reduced-motion fallback; the once-per-turn
   gate and exchange rates are untouched.
- No behaviour change to the action economy: `state.actionsRemaining`,
   `bankedActions`, `favourUsedThisTurn` and the exchange rates are unchanged.

## Minimal Implementation

- Relocate the two SLL anchors in `main-street.layout.json` into the HUD band.
- Move the favour-button construction into `MainStreetRendererHud.refreshHud`
  (parented into `hudContainer`, `markHudTransient`), remove it from `refreshActionButtons`.
- Add `buildCoinsToRepTooltip` / `buildRepToCoinsTooltip` and the i18n keys/strings/aria
  entries in `MainStreetHudTooltips.ts`; attach the tooltip zones.
- Update `tests/main-street/community-favour-ui.test.ts` and
  `community-favour-ui.browser.test.ts`; extend `tests/main-street/hud-tooltips.test.ts`.

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/layouts/main-street.layout.json`
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetLayoutAdapter.ts`
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRendererHud.ts`
- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetHudTooltips.ts`
- `tests/main-street/community-favour-ui.test.ts`
- `tests/main-street/community-favour-ui.browser.test.ts`
- `tests/main-street/hud-tooltips.test.ts`

## Dependencies

- Widen HUD strip and re-lay contents.

data.description:
# Action counter above End Turn (all phases)

Render the actions-remaining counter (`2 actions left (1 banked)`) in the action
cluster directly above the End Turn button, right-aligned with it, instead of inside
the HUD strip. The counter must stay visible in every action-cluster phase
(`market`, `applicant`, `placing-from-hand`, `placing-business`) so the player never
loses sight of the remaining action budget; in the placing phases it sits above the
Cancel button.

Covers parent AC1 (counter relocated + visibility), reuses the existing action
tooltip copy, and the counter part of AC6 (actionContainer parenting).

## Acceptance Criteria
- Parent AC traceability: Actions-remaining counter relocated. The actions-remaining counter is rendered in the action cluster directly above the End Turn button, right-aligned with it, and is no longer rendered inside the HUD strip. The counter remains visible in every action-cluster phase (market, applicant, placing-from-hand, placing-business) so the player never loses sight of the remaining action budget.

- The counter renders in the action cluster with its top edge above the End Turn
   button's top edge and sharing the End Turn button's right edge. Verified by a
   unit/browser assertion on the derived layout values.
- No action-count text object is created within the HUD strip bounds (guard shared
   with the strip child).
- The counter is visible in all four action-cluster phases: `market`, `applicant`,
   `placing-from-hand`, `placing-business`. Verified by a browser assertion per phase
   that the counter text is present in `s.actionContainer`.
- The counter is right-aligned and stacked above the existing "Can buy: ..." summary
   line without overlapping it (documented assumption A1); the summary line remains
   unchanged.
- The existing action tooltip (`buildActionTooltip` / `HUD_ARIA_LABELS.action`) is
   attached to the moved counter with the same content and aria label, and skipped in
   replay mode. No copy is rewritten.
- Colour/banking semantics are preserved: the counter stays green when
   `actionsRemaining > 0` and red otherwise, and the `(N banked)` suffix still renders
   when `bankedActions > 0`.
- The counter is added to `s.actionContainer` (not `hudContainer`) and is cleaned up
   by the existing `actionContainer.removeAll(true)` on each refresh — no leak.

## Minimal Implementation

- Add a shared `renderActionCounter(s, x, by)` helper in `MainStreetRendererHud.ts`
  that renders the counter right-aligned above the button row and attaches the action
  tooltip.
- Call it in all four branches of `refreshActionButtons` (market/applicant, and the two
  placing phases), right-aligned to `s.layout.gameW - 24`.
- Add the position/visibility/phase assertions.

## Key Files

- `example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRendererHud.ts`
- `tests/main-street/community-favour-ui.test.ts` (or a new action-counter test)
- `tests/main-street/tutorial-action-economy.test.ts`
- `tests/main-street/helpers/mainStreetLayoutGeometry.ts`

## Dependencies

- Widen HUD strip and re-lay contents.
